const countBootstrapReservations = `-- name: CountBootstrapReservations :one
WITH reservations AS (
 SELECT i.id,i.not_after FROM fleet_bootstrap_intent i WHERE i.installation_id=$1
 UNION ALL SELECT b.id,b.not_after FROM fleet_bootstrap b WHERE b.installation_id=$1
)
SELECT count(DISTINCT id) AS history_count,
 count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN not_after>$2::timestamptz THEN id END) AS active_count
FROM reservations
`

type CountBootstrapReservationsParams struct {
	InstallationID pgtype.UUID
	CheckTime      pgtype.Timestamptz
}

type CountBootstrapReservationsRow struct {
	HistoryCount int64
	ActiveCount  int64
}

func (q *Queries) CountBootstrapReservations(ctx context.Context, arg CountBootstrapReservationsParams) (CountBootstrapReservationsRow, error) {
	row := q.db.QueryRow(ctx, countBootstrapReservations, arg.InstallationID, arg.CheckTime)
	var i CountBootstrapReservationsRow
	err := row.Scan(&i.HistoryCount, &i.ActiveCount)
	return i, err
}

	InstallationID pgtype.UUID
	ID             pgtype.UUID
}

func (q *Queries) MarkBootstrapIssued(ctx context.Context, arg MarkBootstrapIssuedParams) (int64, error) {
	result, err := q.db.Exec(ctx, markBootstrapIssued, arg.InstallationID, arg.ID)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	return result.RowsAffected(), nil
}

const observeFleetAdministration = `-- name: ObserveFleetAdministration :one
SELECT public.observe_fleet_administration($1::uuid,
 $2::bigint,$3::timestamptz,
 $4::oid,$5::timestamptz,
 $6::uuid,$7::text,$8::bigint,
 $9::bytea,$10::boolean,
 $11::timestamptz,$12::timestamptz)::integer AS disposition
`

type ObserveFleetAdministrationParams struct {
	InstallationID   pgtype.UUID
	SemanticVersion  int64
	PostmasterAt     pgtype.Timestamptz
	DatabaseOid      pgtype.Uint32
	BasisUntil       pgtype.Timestamptz
	IssuerEpoch      pgtype.UUID
	SourceUid        string
	SourceGeneration int64
	SourceDigest     []byte
	Suspended        bool
	ObservedAt       pgtype.Timestamptz
	FreshUntil       pgtype.Timestamptz
}

func (q *Queries) ObserveFleetAdministration(ctx context.Context, arg ObserveFleetAdministrationParams) (int32, error) {
	row := q.db.QueryRow(ctx, observeFleetAdministration,
		arg.InstallationID,
		arg.SemanticVersion,
		arg.PostmasterAt,
		arg.DatabaseOid,
		arg.BasisUntil,
		arg.IssuerEpoch,
		arg.SourceUid,
		arg.SourceGeneration,
		arg.SourceDigest,
		arg.Suspended,
		arg.ObservedAt,
		arg.FreshUntil,
	)
	var disposition int32
	err := row.Scan(&disposition)
	return disposition, err
}

const pendingBootstrapIssues = `-- name: PendingBootstrapIssues :many
SELECT installation_id, id, actor_digest, key_digest, request_digest, actor_json, identity_uid, identity_generation, identity_digest, trust_uid, trust_generation, trust_digest, cluster_id, peer_id, issuer_epoch, delivery_profile, display_name, region, not_before, not_after, credential_recorded_at, credential_sha256, credential_version, audit_acknowledged_at, audit_digest, audit_object_key, audit_object_version, audit_object_etag, audit_object_bytes, audit_object_sha256, issued_at FROM fleet_bootstrap_intent WHERE installation_id=$1 AND credential_recorded_at IS NOT NULL
 AND audit_acknowledged_at IS NULL ORDER BY credential_recorded_at,id LIMIT 2
`

func (q *Queries) PendingBootstrapIssues(ctx context.Context, installationID pgtype.UUID) ([]FleetBootstrapIntent, error) {
	rows, err := q.db.Query(ctx, pendingBootstrapIssues, installationID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	items := []FleetBootstrapIntent{}
	for rows.Next() {
		var i FleetBootstrapIntent
		if err := rows.Scan(
			&i.InstallationID,
			&i.ID,
			&i.ActorDigest,
			&i.KeyDigest,
			&i.RequestDigest,
			&i.ActorJson,
			&i.IdentityUid,
			&i.IdentityGeneration,
			&i.IdentityDigest,
			&i.TrustUid,
			&i.TrustGeneration,
			&i.TrustDigest,
			&i.ClusterID,
			&i.PeerID,
			&i.IssuerEpoch,
			&i.DeliveryProfile,
			&i.DisplayName,
			&i.Region,
			&i.NotBefore,
			&i.NotAfter,
			&i.CredentialRecordedAt,
			&i.CredentialSha256,
			&i.CredentialVersion,
			&i.AuditAcknowledgedAt,
			&i.AuditDigest,
			&i.AuditObjectKey,
			&i.AuditObjectVersion,
			&i.AuditObjectEtag,
			&i.AuditObjectBytes,
			&i.AuditObjectSha256,
			&i.IssuedAt,
		); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		items = append(items, i)
	}
	if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return items, nil
}

const readFleetTrust = `-- name: ReadFleetTrust :one
SELECT installation_id, issuer_epoch, source_uid, source_generation, source_digest, suspended, recovery_blocked, observed_at, fresh_until FROM fleet_current_trust WHERE installation_id=$1
`

func (q *Queries) ReadFleetTrust(ctx context.Context, installationID pgtype.UUID) (FleetCurrentTrust, error) {
	row := q.db.QueryRow(ctx, readFleetTrust, installationID)
	var i FleetCurrentTrust
	err := row.Scan(
		&i.InstallationID,
		&i.IssuerEpoch,
		&i.SourceUid,
		&i.SourceGeneration,
		&i.SourceDigest,
		&i.Suspended,
		&i.RecoveryBlocked,
		&i.ObservedAt,
		&i.FreshUntil,
	)
	return i, err
}

const readPeerRegistration = `-- name: ReadPeerRegistration :many
SELECT t.issuer_epoch AS current_epoch,t.source_uid,t.source_generation,t.source_digest,
 t.suspended,t.recovery_blocked,t.observed_at,t.fresh_until,
 p.cluster_id,p.issuer_epoch,p.role,p.revision,p.enabled,p.not_after AS peer_not_after,
 p.audit_id,p.audit_object_key,p.audit_object_version,p.audit_object_sha256,
 c.certificate_sha256,c.not_before,c.not_after
FROM fleet_current_trust t JOIN fleet_peer p USING(installation_id)
 JOIN fleet_peer_certificate c USING(installation_id,peer_id)
WHERE t.installation_id=$1 AND p.peer_id=$2
ORDER BY c.slot LIMIT 3
`

type ReadPeerRegistrationParams struct {
	InstallationID pgtype.UUID
	PeerID         pgtype.UUID
}

type ReadPeerRegistrationRow struct {
	CurrentEpoch       pgtype.UUID
	SourceUid          string
	SourceGeneration   int64
	SourceDigest       []byte
	Suspended          bool
	RecoveryBlocked    bool
	ObservedAt         pgtype.Timestamptz
	FreshUntil         pgtype.Timestamptz
	ClusterID          pgtype.UUID
	IssuerEpoch        pgtype.UUID
	Role               string
	Revision           int64
	Enabled            bool
	PeerNotAfter       pgtype.Timestamptz
	AuditID            pgtype.UUID
	AuditObjectKey     pgtype.Text
	AuditObjectVersion pgtype.Text
	AuditObjectSha256  []byte
	CertificateSha256  []byte
	NotBefore          pgtype.Timestamptz
	NotAfter           pgtype.Timestamptz
}

// One statement snapshot, no replica and no side effects. observed_start is
// supplied from a DB clock read BEFORE this potentially blocking lookup.
func (q *Queries) ReadPeerRegistration(ctx context.Context, arg ReadPeerRegistrationParams) ([]ReadPeerRegistrationRow, error) {
	rows, err := q.db.Query(ctx, readPeerRegistration, arg.InstallationID, arg.PeerID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	items := []ReadPeerRegistrationRow{}
	for rows.Next() {
		var i ReadPeerRegistrationRow
		if err := rows.Scan(
			&i.CurrentEpoch,
			&i.SourceUid,
			&i.SourceGeneration,
			&i.SourceDigest,
			&i.Suspended,
			&i.RecoveryBlocked,
			&i.ObservedAt,
			&i.FreshUntil,
			&i.ClusterID,
			&i.IssuerEpoch,
			&i.Role,
			&i.Revision,
			&i.Enabled,
			&i.PeerNotAfter,
			&i.AuditID,
			&i.AuditObjectKey,
			&i.AuditObjectVersion,
			&i.AuditObjectSha256,
			&i.CertificateSha256,
			&i.NotBefore,
			&i.NotAfter,
		); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		items = append(items, i)
	}
	if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return items, nil
}

const recordBootstrapCredential = `-- name: RecordBootstrapCredential :one
UPDATE fleet_bootstrap_intent SET credential_recorded_at=clock_timestamp(),credential_sha256=$3,credential_version=1
WHERE installation_id=$1 AND id=$2 AND credential_recorded_at IS NULL RETURNING installation_id, id, actor_digest, key_digest, request_digest, actor_json, identity_uid, identity_generation, identity_digest, trust_uid, trust_generation, trust_digest, cluster_id, peer_id, issuer_epoch, delivery_profile, display_name, region, not_before, not_after, credential_recorded_at, credential_sha256, credential_version, audit_acknowledged_at, audit_digest, audit_object_key, audit_object_version, audit_object_etag, audit_object_bytes, audit_object_sha256, issued_at
`

type RecordBootstrapCredentialParams struct {
	InstallationID   pgtype.UUID
	ID               pgtype.UUID
	CredentialSha256 []byte
}

func (q *Queries) RecordBootstrapCredential(ctx context.Context, arg RecordBootstrapCredentialParams) (FleetBootstrapIntent, error) {
	row := q.db.QueryRow(ctx, recordBootstrapCredential, arg.InstallationID, arg.ID, arg.CredentialSha256)
	var i FleetBootstrapIntent
	err := row.Scan(
		&i.InstallationID,
		&i.ID,
		&i.ActorDigest,
		&i.KeyDigest,
		&i.RequestDigest,
		&i.ActorJson,
		&i.IdentityUid,
		&i.IdentityGeneration,
		&i.IdentityDigest,
		&i.TrustUid,
		&i.TrustGeneration,
		&i.TrustDigest,
		&i.ClusterID,
		&i.PeerID,
		&i.IssuerEpoch,
		&i.DeliveryProfile,
		&i.DisplayName,
		&i.Region,
		&i.NotBefore,
		&i.NotAfter,
		&i.CredentialRecordedAt,
		&i.CredentialSha256,
		&i.CredentialVersion,
		&i.AuditAcknowledgedAt,
		&i.AuditDigest,
		&i.AuditObjectKey,
		&i.AuditObjectVersion,
		&i.AuditObjectEtag,
		&i.AuditObjectBytes,
		&i.AuditObjectSha256,
		&i.IssuedAt,
	)
	return i, err
}

const shareFleetTrust = `-- name: ShareFleetTrust :one

`

	var i FleetCurrentTrust

		&i.InstallationID,
		&i.IssuerEpoch,
		&i.SourceUid,
		&i.SourceGeneration,
		&i.SourceDigest,
		&i.Suspended,
		&i.RecoveryBlocked,
		&i.ObservedAt,
		&i.FreshUntil,
	)

}

const storeConnectorCertificate = `-- name: StoreConnectorCertificate :execrows
UPDATE fleet_certificate_issue SET signed_at=clock_timestamp(),certificate_json=$3,certificate_sha256=$4,
 certificate_not_before=$5,certificate_not_after=$6
WHERE installation_id=$1 AND id=$2 AND signed_at IS NULL AND clock_timestamp()<sign_before
`

type StoreConnectorCertificateParams struct {
	InstallationID       pgtype.UUID
	ID                   pgtype.UUID
	CertificateJson      []byte
	CertificateSha256    []byte
	CertificateNotBefore pgtype.Timestamptz
	CertificateNotAfter  pgtype.Timestamptz
}

func (q *Queries) StoreConnectorCertificate(ctx context.Context, arg StoreConnectorCertificateParams) (int64, error) {
	result, err := q.db.Exec(ctx, storeConnectorCertificate,
		arg.InstallationID,
		arg.ID,
		arg.CertificateJson,
		arg.CertificateSha256,
		arg.CertificateNotBefore,
		arg.CertificateNotAfter,
	)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	return result.RowsAffected(), nil
}
